title: KILL-CHECK pre-registration -- do the VWAP-family entries produce a right tail at all?
frozen_at_et: 2026-08-18 (market CLOSED -- et_clock.py verified market_hours=False at freeze time)
shadow_only: MEASUREMENT ONLY -- nothing is disabled by this file. The kill it contemplates is a one-line producer flag, taken only if the forward bar below fails.
why_this_is_a_MECHANISM_question_not_an_: The parent study established that this book's entire P&L is a right tail: exits at >=1.3x entry premium are 23% of fills and carry $17,067, while the 1.0-1.3x band is 50 fills for $900 against a -$18,635 loss book. A strategy family that structurally cannot reach 1.3x is therefore not 'badly tuned' -- it is a negative-expectancy tax on a business whose only product is the tail. The discriminating measurement is MFE (maximum favorable excursion), because MFE answers what the trade OFFERED, independent of what our exit shape took. If MFE is there and we did not capture it, that is an exit problem. If MFE was never there, no exit shape can fix it.

the_measurement_that_prompted_this.source: analysis/pain-ledger/mae-mfe.json -- real Alpaca OPRA 1-min bars, FULL population (winners AND losers), entry+1 convention, 308 scored positions

ribbon_ride.note: the entries DO produce runners -- 87% of its winners offered >=+50%

vwap_continuation.note: even its WINNERS top out around +10%. There is no tail to harvest and zero evidence of an exit failing to capture one.

vwap_reclaim_failed_break.note: n=3 scored. Reported for completeness ONLY -- this arm of the family is NOT judgeable and is explicitly excluded from the verdict below.

hypothesis: H-VWAP-NOTAIL: vwap_continuation entries do not produce the >=1.3x excursions this book requires, and its realized loss is therefore structural rather than a tuning defect.

candidates.kill_mechanism: one producer flag in automation/state/fleet/build_shared_signal.py (same shape as the documented RUN_VWAP_RECLAIM_FB kill switch). Fully revertible, paper-only, no params.json edit.
candidates.do_not_kill_yet_because: 41 scored positions collapse to ~6 independent impulse waves. Wave-level that is an anecdote, and killing a family on an anecdote is exactly how this repo's strategy graveyard acquired entries that should have lived.

explicitly_out_of_scope: vwap_reclaim_failed_break -- n=3 scored positions. NOT judgeable. It rides the same suspicion but must accumulate its own evidence; folding it in to make the sample look bigger is the pooling error this repo already knows about (C4).

ribbon_ride -- the opposite verdict. It produces the tail (27% of ALL its fills offer >=+50%) and its own historical leak was closed by the 2026-08-10 pre_tp1_ladder ship. Nothing here proposes touching it.

Any exit re-tune for the VWAP family. With MFE p90 at +17%, no exit shape is reachable that changes the outcome; proposing one would be optimizing under a constraint whose provenance was never checked (OP-32).

measurement_protocol.mode: SHADOW. vwap_continuation keeps trading paper unchanged through the window -- TRADE-TO-LEARN standing. The forward evidence is the paper fills themselves.
measurement_protocol.instrument: analysis/pain-ledger/mae-mfe.json, already produced nightly by Gamma_PainLedger. No new counter is built -- the measurement already exists and this pre-registration only names the query and freezes the bar.
measurement_protocol.query: trades[] where setup in (VWAP_CONTINUATION, vwap_continuation) and date >= 2026-08-18; report n, median mfe_pct, pct with mfe_pct >= 0.50, and realized_pnl
measurement_protocol.window: the next 20 sessions with at least one vwap_continuation fill, OR n>=25 forward scored positions, whichever comes first
measurement_protocol.no_peeking_rule: no interim kill, no bar edits inside the window. If the bar needs to move, this pre-registration is VOID and a new one is written.
measurement_protocol.cost: $0 -- the ledger is already built nightly.

forward_gates.K1_tail_presence: at least 15% of forward vwap_continuation positions reach mfe_pct >= 0.50 (ribbon_ride, the family that works, runs 27%; 15% is deliberately set BELOW it so the bar is 'produces a tail at all', not 'matches the best family')
forward_gates.K2_not_merely_unlucky: if K1 passes but realized P&L is still negative, the verdict is EXIT-PROBLEM, not KILL -- the tail existed and we failed to capture it, which is a different study
forward_gates.K3_frequency: n >= 25 forward scored positions; below that EXTEND, judge nothing

verdict_ladder.KILL: K3 met and K1 FAILS -- flip the producer flag, report for REVOKE (paper-only, one line, revertible)
verdict_ladder.EXIT_STUDY: K3 met, K1 passes, K2 triggers -- open a separate pre-registered exit study; do NOT kill
verdict_ladder.KEEP: K3 met, K1 passes, forward P&L non-negative

falsification_note: The honest way this pre-registration dies: forward MFE comes in materially above the in-sample +5% median. That would mean the in-sample window caught vwap_continuation in an unrepresentative regime -- entirely possible on ~6 independent waves -- and the family deserves to keep trading. Written down now so a future session cannot quietly re-read the bar after seeing the data.
